description: Test the functionality of logging in with a Google account, ensuring redirection to the Google OAuth page, proper authentication, and returning to the platform dashboard.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Locate and click the 'Sign in with Google' button.
Verify redirection to the Google OAuth page.
Enter valid Google account credentials (email and password).
Complete any two-factor authentication if prompted.
Consent to the requested permissions for the Roost application.
Verify redirection back to the dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
Check that the user is logged in by verifying the presence of a user-specific element on the dashboard.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Google OAuth page.
User successfully authenticates using Google credentials.
User is redirected back to the Roost dashboard.
A user-specific element is visible, confirming successful login.
edge_cases: User cancels the OAuth process midway.
User does not consent to requested permissions.
The Google OAuth service is temporarily unavailable.
data_requirements: A valid Google account with access to the platform.
Two-factor authentication setup for the test account.
Pre-configured permissions for the Roost application in the Google account.
A clean session with no existing cookies.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be operational.
Test account must be active and accessible.
Roost application must be registered with Google OAuth.
api_interactions: Roost API for user session creation.
Roost dashboard endpoint for user-specific data.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect to Google OAuth.
Time taken to authenticate and return to the dashboard.
Response time of the Roost dashboard after login.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Sign in with Google' button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify that the button has an appropriate ARIA label.
Ensure screen readers announce the button correctly.
Check that error messages are accessible and descriptive.
